'''Maydla Churhee''' was the wife of [[Vlaydm Churhee]], the leader of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] force [[Churhee's Riflemen]]. Whilst on a [[Mission on Y'Trella|mission]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Y'Trella system/Legends|Y'Trella system]], the Riflemen became pinned down and were abandoned by Imperial forces, who had promised to back them up. Most of the Riflemen, including Vlaydm, were wiped out and the survivors regrouped on [[Turcan III]]. Maydla became their new leader and she aligned the group with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
